verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a comprehensive REST API for programmatic setup, scaling, and account management (fivetran-docs-3, fivetran-docs-22), with getting-started guides and Connect Cards for onboarding (fivetran-docs-23), plus a public Connector SDK for extending functionality via code. This is corroborated by an official MCP server built atop the API enabling agentic access (fivetran-docs-28/29/60/61), showing the API is robust enough to power external tooling. Missing for 10: independent developer confirmation of API completeness/reliability (one community comment calls Fivetran APIs 'unreliable', fivetran-comm-6), and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable via probes (fivetran-probe-3).
